articles.title: 21 Former Cricket Captains Urge Shehbaz Sharif To Ensure ‘Humane Treatment’ For Jailed Imran Khan
articles.description: Twenty-one former international cricket captains from nine countries have written to Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, urging his government to ensure proper medical care and humane treatment for jailed former Pakistan captain and prime minister Imran Khan.The appeal follows concerns over Khan's reported vision loss and claims that a Supreme Court-directed medical board, including his personal doctors, was not allowed to complete its assessment before he was returned to Adiala Jail.Among the signatories are Sunil Gavaskar, Kapil Dev, Adam Gilchrist, Steve Waugh, Nasser Hussain, Alastair Cook and Clive Lloyd. The former captains have also urged authorities to ensure Khan's family visitation rights and provide any treatment recommended by the medical board.Major point: The cricket legends stressed that their appeal is not about politics, but about ensuring that a court-ordered medical process is completed and that Imran Khan receives proper and timely care. n18oc_breaking-news CNN-News18 is your trusted source for breaking news, updates, and in-depth analysis from around the world.
